sections.heading: Why teams adopt edge caching
sections.text: Edge caching moves content closer to users. A regional cache in front of an origin can cut median response time from 180 ms to 35 ms.

sections.heading: Costs
sections.text: Egress from the origin fell by 62% in the first quarter after rollout, saving about $14,000 per month.
